text: All right, so what I think would be cool is a graphical timeline that attempts to put all of these timestamped things like an event log that uses spatial adjustments to represent how far away things are. And so I think the key there is you kind of need a scale that adapts to what time frame you're looking at. So think timeline UX, how do we have a grid of, definitely one every hour. So you'd mark like four o'clock, five o'clock, whatever. So we can see that kind of benchmark timeline in the log. And then each thing that comes in, you'd probably mark each minute. Not every minute, but the minutes above and below where the things come in. And then you could even have sub minute, the seconds, the thing positioned within the minute. And so I would imagine this thing would scroll automatically. And as time goes by, you don't necessarily have to show huge gaps as huge gaps. You would just have a four o'clock dot dot dot six o'clock and then restart the timeline and so you kind of get a sense for the days and the hours
